sectionHeadings: 3.3 The hooks read and never write
4.1 The harness was nominally hashed and actually was not
4.2 The committed registry was compiled by an older binary
4.3 CI repaired the tree it was judging
4.4 A record spec blocked the planner
record.summary: The harness is what an agent may do in this repository, so it is claimed by a spec and held by the coupling gate rather than living as untracked convention. statecraft adopts the spec-spine kit whole (ten skills, four pipeline agents, four rules, the read-only session hooks, the composite Makefile gate) at the 0.18.0 floor, and moves the project layer that the skills read into AGENTS.md so the skills stay byte-identical to the kit and a kit update is a copy rather than a merge. Three defects the adoption exposed are fixed here: the harness globs matched directories and hashed nothing, the session hooks repaired the tree they were reading, and the CI gate ran a writing `compile` against the branch it was judging.
record.title: The agent harness: the spec-spine kit as statecraft's governed loop
